title: FFRDC spun off from TRW as principal contractor for about 29 years
summary: Eric Davis tells of FFRDC spun off from TRW as principal contractor for about 29 years, about 1960s-1989 at an unknown place, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: only one and I won't name it um started out as a contractor in 1960s 30 not too long after it was born was actually spin-off of TRW

plain: Eric Davis, a physicist who has worked on Pentagon research, says on Jesse Michels' podcast that one government-funded research center, a nonprofit lab paid for by the federal government, began as a contractor in the 1960s after being spun off from TRW, a big American defense and aerospace company. He says, without naming it, that it was the main contractor for about 29 years, until around 1989, in work studying recovered non-human craft to copy their technology.
